title: Add PubMedBERT to Biomedical text and knowledge models
body:
### Summary of Changes

Added **PubMedBERT** to the `Biomedical text and knowledge models` section in `README.md`.

* **Model Added:** PubMedBERT (`microsoft/BiomedNLP-PubMedBERT-base-uncased-abstract-fulltext`)
* **What it does & Pretraining Data/Scale:** Domain-specific BERT-style language model pretrained from scratch on PubMed abstracts and PubMed Central full-text articles (over 14 million abstracts and 3+ million full-text papers).
* **Why it qualifies as a biological foundation model:** It is a domain-specific representation model trained on extensive biomedical literature to serve as a foundational text model for diverse downstream biomedical NLP tasks including named entity recognition, relation extraction, question answering, and document classification.
* **Primary URL:** https://huggingface.co/microsoft/BiomedNLP-PubMedBERT-base-uncased-abstract-fulltext
* **Publication:** ACM Transactions on Computing for Healthcare (2021) / arXiv:2007.15779 (Domain-Specific Language Model Pretraining for Biomedical Natural Language Processing)
